subject: op-spd
title: (R)OP.SPD.------VT.PLT.
description: Diagram in SR(TRS)II-6 (Social Reality / Trans-Information, Level Two) accompanying Braxton's claim that 'the next cycle in western culture promises to be very … interesting' — interesting because the late-seventies sentiment (that injustices have been corrected) sets up a particular vibrational position for what follows. (R)OP-SPD (the reality of option-spread) is crossed with VT-PLT (vibrational platform): the question is what option-spread produces in its actual instantiation when crossed with vibrational-platform — the (R) prefix marking Braxton's commitment that option-spread is what actually obtains for late-seventies America. ALT-ACT (alternative activism) hangs from the DYM-SPT line at the upper-left. DYM-SPT (dynamic spiritualism) sits centrally between subject and partner. VT-PLT is the partner. AFI (affinity insight) anchors the upper-right output. RT-DY (reality dynamics) sits below the crossing. EXT-DYM (extended dynamics) anchors the lower-center. WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle) hangs from the AFI line on the lower right and carries RT-DY, from whose line EXT-DYM descends.
